children: POSITIVE INTERIM DATA SHOWS ROCHE'S SEFAXERSEN SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCES PROTEINURIA IN PEOPLE WITH IGA NEPHROPATHY (IGAN)
INTERIM DATA WILL BE PRESENTED AT AN UPCOMING MEDICAL MEETING AND SHARED WITH HEALTH AUTHORITIES
IN PHASE III IMAGINATION STUDY, SEFAXERSEN DEMONSTRATED STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT AND CLINICALLY MEANINGFUL REDUCTIONS IN PROTEINURIA VERSUS PLACEBO AT 37 WEEKS, SHOWING BEST-IN-CLASS POTENTIAL
SAFETY AND TOLERABILITY PROFILE OF SEFAXERSEN WAS CONSISTENT WITH PREVIOUSLY REPORTED DATA, WITH NO NEW SAFETY SIGNALS IDENTIFIED
THE STUDY MET ITS PRIMARY ENDPOINT WITH SEFAXERSEN ACHIEVING STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT AND CLINICALLY MEANINGFUL IMPROVEMENTS
